name: Otahime Ryougyaku Circle ~Yamihime no Otoko Jijou~
original_name: オタ姫凌虐サークル ～病み姫の男事情～
source: The story follows a student named Sugihara Natsuki, who joins an otaku club and meets the only female member, Mizushiro Kaoruko, who is a typical otaku girl that wears lolita clothes and doesn't use makeup. Natsuki and Kaoruko become close and eventually start a romantic relationship, but Kaoruko's status as a "taken" girl leads her to become arrogant and cause conflicts with other girls in their school. In order to feel valued again, Kaoruko decides to become the "princess" of the otaku club, which causes Natsuki to feel excluded and unsure of their relationship.
translation: 故事讲述了一名名叫杉原夏树的学生加入了一个御宅族俱乐部，并遇到了唯一的女性成员水代薰子，她是一个典型的穿着洛丽塔衣服、不化妆的御宅族女孩。夏希和薰子变得亲密并最终开始了恋爱关系，但薰子作为“被带走”女孩的身份导致她变得傲慢并与学校的其他女孩发生冲突。为了再次感受到被重视，薰子决定成为御宅族俱乐部的“公主”，这让夏树感到被排斥，并对他们的关系感到不确定。
